to: you: only the socket of the character

fields.name: name
fields.description: The skill. For a skill with `share` in G, the skill that it shares the cooldown with, for example `"quickpunch"` for `quickstab`, or `"use_hp"` for `regen_hp` (node/server_functions.js:3452-3455).

fields.name: ms
fields.description: The time until the skill is ready. From `consume_skill`, it includes `penalty`. The `attack_ms` form can be 0 or less: then the skill is ready now.

fields.name: penalty
fields.description: Only from `consume_skill`: the part of `ms` that comes from the `penalty_cd` condition, up to 10,000. Often `0`.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Only when the attack speed changed: `ms` is `attack_ms - (time since the last attack)` (node/server.js:1630-1634).

confirm.note: From node/logic/instance_pause.js the cooldown of `attack` is `1000 / frequency`, so `ms` can have a fraction.

senders.what: `consume_skill`: the `skill` handler after a skill succeeds. The cooldown is `G.skills[name].cooldown * cooldown_multiplier`. A skill without a cooldown sends nothing.
`consume_skill` with `reuse` (the cooldown is `reuse_cooldown`): `step_out_of_invis` when an action ends `invis`, and the end of `pickpocket`, `fishing` and `mining`.
`consume_skill` from the `absorb` branch of `skill` (an absorb that fails on a target that is not friendly).
`calculate_player_stats`: the attack speed changed, for example after `equip`. It has `reason: "attack_ms"` and no `penalty`.
The end of a cave pause, or the end of the entry to the Cave of Many Dreams. It sends each cooldown that is not over, with `name` and `ms` only.
